builds_on: v6 (serving/performance); v7 adds the four feature gaps from the external honest review

verification_actually_run_here.frontend_build: tsc --noEmit && vite build passed. 1584 modules. Shell 259.84 kB, Plotly lazy chunk 4.84 MB (v6 code-splitting confirmed working).
verification_actually_run_here.live_end_to_end: demo run -> cyclone-context CLI -> cold-wake CLI -> /field, /profile, /cyclone/context, /cyclone/cold-wake, /baselines all served through the real FastAPI app.
verification_actually_run_here.controlled_numeric_check: cold_wake recovers an injected -2.0 C cooling exactly (abs tol 1e-6) in tests/test_cyclone.py.

bugs_found_and_fixed_in_this_releases_ow: Reason precedence: 'no_value' overwrote the more informative 'below_seabed'/'dry_cell'. Structural reasons now win, so the reported reason explains the absence.
All-NaN RuntimeWarning in field_states when every surface channel was missing at a cell; replaced nanmax with a masked max over cells that have at least one finite channel.

design_decisions_worth_re_reading_before.shallow_profiles: A profile's overall state is the worst state among REPORTING depths. A 400 m water column stays Supported for the 12 levels it has, with depths_reporting published. Marking every shelf profile Abstain would make the gate useless.
design_decisions_worth_re_reading_before.calibration_separate_from_state: calibration_applies is a separate field. A Supported point on an uncalibrated run must not imply coverage.
design_decisions_worth_re_reading_before.baselines_separate_from_validation: /baselines is reanalysis-target agreement; /validation is held-out observational agreement. They are never merged.
design_decisions_worth_re_reading_before.persistence_own_n: Persistence is undefined across time gaps and reports its own per-depth n. Compare counts, not just RMSE.
design_decisions_worth_re_reading_before.cyclone_is_retrospective: Best-track overlay describes a past storm's ocean state. Never an intensity or RI forecast. IMD categories never remapped to Saffir-Simpson.

still_not_done: No real ocean data (STOP 2 never run) - every number shown is synthetic or CPU-smoke-test
No GPU training; model has never trained to convergence
No measured scientific skill; no real Argo RMSE exists
No real IMD/RSMC best-track file has been ingested - the cyclone adapter is tested against fixtures only
Browser visual/interaction QA not performed in this sandbox (no browser tool available here)
Adaptation training stage, learned uncertainty scaling, attention, WOA prior remain optional roadmap items
honest_bottom_line: The four named feature gaps are closed in code and tested. That makes the demo complete, not validated. The review's most important finding - that no real-data validation number exists - is unchanged and can only be closed by running STOP 2.

attacked: cyclone CLI commands run through the real argparse entry point
real_bugs_found_and_fixed: field_states/profile_state accepted negative max_age_hours/edge_cells and mismatched-shape arrays silently or with a raw IndexError instead of raising a clear ValueError. Both now validate explicitly.
confirmed_already_correct: empty CSV raises 'No usable track points found'
out-of-range lat raises a clear coordinate error
cold_wake already deduplicated repeated grid cells (existing behaviour, reconfirmed)
depth == bathymetry treated as supported (deepest valid observation), not below_seabed
